Who We Are

Built on Trust & Expertise

Shri Bankey Bihari Properties & Construction is a leading real estate consultancy based in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh. With deep roots in the NCR property market and authorised dealings across YEIDA, GNIDA, and UPSIDA zones, we have earned the trust of hundreds of families and investors.


Our office at Neelkanth Plaza, Alpha-1 — strategically located near ICIC Bank Metro Station — places us at the heart of Greater Noida's commercial activity, allowing us to serve clients swiftly and effectively.
